description: Navigate to the 'app-bundle-v2.0.zip' artifact located in 'example-repo-local' under the path 'com/acme/app/2.0/'. Use the Artifactory Archive Browsing feature (expand the zip file in the Artifacts tree) to find the 'config.properties' file inside it. View the file's content and save the text exactly as it appears to '/home/ga/recovered_config.properties'. Do not download the entire zip file.
